name: Vertex Search
instructions:
### Relationships
- A lesson has no course field. Find its course by reverse reference: *[_type == "course" && references(^._id)][0].
- Module and lesson labels ("Module 5", "Lesson 5.1") are never stored. They come from 1-based array order: course.modules[] order, then modules[].lessons[] order.
- A video document maps to its lesson through video.url == lesson.videoUrl (not by id). Video documents are internal; always report the lesson, never the video itself.

### Text matching
- Split the query into keywords, drop stop words, wildcard each one, and OR them: title match ["data*", "fetching*"]. Never match the whole phrase as one pattern.
- lesson.notes is Portable Text. Match it through pt::text(notes), never the raw array.
- text::semanticSimilarity is not available (embeddings are off). Use match only.

### Lessons
- Search title, pt::text(notes) and keyPoints[]. Rank with score(boost(title match $terms, 3), pt::text(notes) match $terms, keyPoints[] match $terms) | order(_score desc).

### Video moments
- Match chapters first: chapters[label match $terms]{startSeconds, label}.
- Only if a video has no matching chapter, fall back to chunks[text match $terms][0...3]{startSeconds, text}.
- Never project the whole chunks or chapters array. It overflows the context window.

### Grounding
- Every lessonId and startSeconds you report must come from a query result. Never invent courses, lessons, timestamps, durations or counts.
